text: SPLIT OFF from the c63e91b/a0fbf01 block, which the chief has now LIFTED. Those commits fix the urgent half: main's SignatureProjection substitutes 0.0 for five absent components (fidelity, specificity, worldChronology, causalPreservation, worldBackwardMass) and scores an unknown weight key as 0.0, so 'we did not measure this' is published as 'this scored worst' - or, under a negative weight, best. m1's version refuses via MissingComponent/UnknownComponent instead. THIS BEAD IS THE REMAINING HALF: apply still returns Either[ProjectionError, Double], a bare scalar summed from components whose support differs - backwardMass may rest on two comparable steps while compression rests on every unit - so the published scalar cannot report what it stood on. m1 must choose and DEFEND on the board which estimand a multi-component projection is: defined only when every weighted component is comparably supported, refusing otherwise; or defined on the supported subset and publishing the WEAKEST contributing term's support, a chain being no better supported than its thinnest link. Chief leans to the second because the first makes the projection useless on real recalls. Whichever is chosen becomes a named, documented estimand. NOT urgent in the way the zero-substitution was; do not let it block the fix again.
